name: executable
description: TypeScript Node.js app packaged as a standalone executable for Linux, Windows and macOS

scripts.prepare-build: npm run check-types && npm run fetch-natives && npm run bundle
scripts.build: npm run build:wdi && npm run prepare-build && pkg . --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --out-path dist
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare-build && pkg . --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --targets node22-linux-x64 --output dist/executable-linux
scripts.build:win: npm run build:wdi && npm run prepare-build && pkg . --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/executable-win.exe
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare-build && pkg . --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --targets node22-macos-x64,node22-macos-arm64 --out-path dist
scripts.build:apk: bash src/android/generate_apk.sh && mkdir -p dist && cp src/android/output/LockdownMDM-release.apk dist/device-owner.apk
scripts.build:installer-linux: npm run bundle && pkg . --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --targets node22-linux-x64 --output dist/.executable-linux.tmp && mv dist/.executable-linux.tmp dist/executable-linux
scripts.watch:installer: nodemon --watch src --ext ts --ignore "src/**/*.test.ts" --ignore src/server.ts --ignore src/apk-config.ts --ignore src/auth.ts --exec "npm run build:installer-linux"
